packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates automerge once CI is green. CI runs every test against a real gateway image in sandbox mode.
GitHub Actions are pinned to a commit SHA and never automerged, the same rule as proxlane/proxlane.
pytest 9 requires Python 3.10. This repository tests on 3.9 because that is macOS's system python3, so pytest stays on 8.x until 3.9 leaves the CI matrix.
